assessment.rationale: All 12 allowed pressure/shelf pairs were simulated with the native LyoPRONTO 1.2.0 solver on the LPN-6f03bb7659 characterization (authored synthetic knownRp example; simulator-world, not experimental validation). Constraints applied per candidate: maximum returned vial-BOTTOM temperature at or below T_pr_crit -22.0 C; whole-batch peak sublimation rate at or below the equipment line a+b*P_Torr = -0.182+11.7*P (0.403 kg/h at 0.05 Torr, 0.988 kg/h at 0.1 Torr, 2.158 kg/h at 0.2 Torr), with total product area derived as 3000 vials x 3.14 cm2 = 0.942 m2; and drying to 100% within the 60 h horizon. Rejections: -5 C and +10 C shelves exceed -22 C bottom temperature at every pressure (e.g. -20.35 C at 0.1 Torr/-5 C); 0.05 Torr/-15 C exceeds the equipment line (peak 0.4145 vs 0.403 kg/h); 0.2 Torr/-25 C stopped at 85.18% dried at the 60 h horizon. Fastest feasible complete-drying pair: 0.1 Torr chamber pressure with -15 C shelf setpoint, predicted completion 30.11 h at 100% dried. Its maximum returned bottom temperature is -24.47 C, a thermal margin of 2.47 C below T_pr_crit. Peak flux 0.4298 kg/h/m2 converts to a whole-batch peak of 0.4049 kg/h versus the 0.988 kg/h line, a capacity margin of 0.583 kg/h. Checks are on returned solver nodes only; no continuous-maximum guarantee. Margins and whole-batch rate are derived from the native simulated values and source characterization constants. No measured outcome is inferred; this record is a reviewable draft, not an approval.
